label: rem:swampland-distance-conjecture
title: Swampland correspondence: the brane tower and the Distance Conjecture
html:
The recursive brane tower A_0 \hookrightarrow A_1 \hookrightarrow A_2 \hookrightarrow \cdots and its direct limit \mathcal{A}_\infty = \varinjlim_n \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_n) provide a categorical counterpart of the Swampland Distance Conjecture.

The Swampland statement. Traversing an infinite geodesic distance \Delta\phi in moduli space produces an infinite tower of states whose masses fall exponentially, m \sim m_0\, e^{-c\,\Delta\phi}. The local effective field theory description breaks down [ooguri-vafa2007].

QOU translation. Each jet prolongation J^1(A_n) adds a floor to the tower. Interaction defects of order \geq 3 that cannot be absorbed at level n ascend one jet level at a time , the degree-0 algebra vanishes while higher-degree jet data leak through. The fibre-valued particle-identity description fails. Only the tower of higher-order data survives. This serves as the categorical analogue of an effective description breaking down into a surviving tower of states.

Scope. The brane tower, its colimit, and the jet horizon are defined. The horizon is Lean-formalised. Identifying the transfinite limit with an infinite-distance point of a moduli space is interpretive. Reading the jet-horizon vanishing A_0 \to 0 as the generic endpoint of that limit is also interpretive. The framework carries no metric moduli space. A global Frobenius degeneration at the limit is not established. The axioms propagate Frobenius non-degeneracy up the tower. We read the dictionary in one direction. The jet horizon furnishes a concrete instance of the Distance-Conjecture picture, not a proof of it.
